notes.title: YoloMic release!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

Welcome to launch day of our little indie studio's first steam app: YoloMic. After years of low voluming headphones while waiting for door knocks, the idea bubble grew and YoloMic popped out.

By default it tries to isolate background noise (like the AC) using a history comparison. Planning to add a fancy AI one next that will learn to better separate normal from unusual sounds.

Remember to look at the settings in YoloMic taskbar icon where you can tweak display themes, audio sensitivity, and noise isolation.

Please send suggestions, concerns, bugs to support@dragonrisegames.com

Enjoy! ːsteamhappyː
